name: authifyWeb Verification Widget
author: webVerts

sections.description:
The authifyWeb Verification Widget helps site admins to easily link your authifyWeb profile directly on your WordPress site with a shortcode. It is suitable for both authifyBrand Pages and authifyFame profile card.

Features

  • Easy to Manage: Admins only has to submit their authifyWeb profile link. Everything else is automatic.
  • Verify any page: Automatically pass the active page URL to verify. Best suitable for multi-network sites as well as individual websites.
  • Shortcode: Use [vwfaw_authifyweb-sc-widget] to display the widget anywhere you like.
  • Official WordPress Plugin: Specifically built for WordPress, ensuring optimized and easy installation
  • Free to use: This plugin is completely free to use. Though, you should need an active authifyWeb account.
  • Widget Placement: Best advised to use it on footer or on sidebar.
  • Add authifyWeb microdata into head section.
  • Create Account: A valid authifyWeb account is necessary inorder for this free widget to work properly. Claim your account here now.

authifyWeb stands as the guardian of authenticity for online interactions, ensuring that digital experiences are secure, verified, and free from fraud. authifyWeb offer a unique and secure space where users can verify your online presence, making sure your customer connect with the real you.

Identifying scam sites is challenging for users. Make it easy for your customers to verify your websites, social media, and much more, making scam detection efficient and easy.

  • Instant Verification
  • Unlimited Company Websites
  • 30+ Third-Party Websites

Affordably priced making it suitable for small business and large corporates alike.

With its robust features and commitment to privacy, authifyWeb makes the online world a safer place for everyone.
sections.installation:
This section describes how to install the plugin and get it working.

  • Search for authifyWeb verification widget plugin.
  • Install the plugin directly.
  • Activate the plugin.
  • Open authifyWeb settings page under ‘Users’ > ‘authifyWeb Settings’.
  • Update with your authifyWeb profile URL and save.
  • Copy and paste the [vwfaw_authifyweb-sc-widget], wherever you want the widget to be displayed.
sections.faq:
Will it work with any theme?

Yes it should. Any theme that accepts shortcode will work.

Will it work with a multi-user blog

No. You can at a time add only one authifyWeb user profile. Though, if the purpose is to verify the main user behind the blog, it is possible.

Where can I find docs for this plugin?

HelpDocs for authifyWeb WordPress Plugin
